jq.description:
jq filter applied to the JSON output. Ignored when `python`
is also set — python overrides jq.

max_tokens.description:
Response token budget, `>= 1` (`0` is rejected at parse
time — omit entirely for unlimited). Forward-compatible
envelope data — no leaf enforces it yet.

owner.description:
GitHub `<owner>` segment, lowercased on arrival — the
declaration layer lowercases it too, so the registration and an
agent's `plugin` entry agree.

path.description:
ABSOLUTE path to the plugin's source directory: the one holding
`objectiveai.json`. Absolute because the VIEWER resolves it,
and its working directory is not yours.

python.description:
Python transform applied to the JSON output. Overrides `jq`
when both are provided.

timeout_seconds.description:
Wall-clock execution cap, in whole seconds. Parsed from
`--timeout` (humantime: `30s`, `5m`, `1h30m`), `> 0`
enforced at parse time. `db query` threads it to postgres
when set; omit for uncapped.

version.description:
Plugin version — matched byte-for-byte against what an agent
declares. It stays case-sensitive even though nothing is
fetched — it is part of every `plugin://` URL.
